name: Fish Pose
description: A backbend lying on your back: lift your chest and let the crown of your head rest lightly on the floor, forearms flat beside you.
setup: Lie on your back, legs long, arms by your sides.
cues: Press your forearms and elbows down to lift your chest.
Keep the weight off your head.

keyframes.name: Lie on your back
keyframes.cue: Legs long, arms by your sides.

keyframes.name: Fish Pose
keyframes.cue: Lift your chest, crown of the head light on the floor.

prescription.note: Breathe slowly and evenly; come out of the pose if anything pinches.
